gbm_population_evidence.quote: The pathological result of glioblastoma WHO grade 4;

candidate_evidence.quote: Pembrolizumab 200mg once every 3 weeks until progression;

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: The primary objective of this study is to evaluate the safety of an innovative integrated treatment regimen for recurrent glioblastoma , including patients with recurrent glioblastoma multiforme.

role_evidence.quote: Pembrolizumab 200mg once every 3 weeks until progression;
After enrollment, temozolomide 50mg/m2 was given orally for QD until progression, and radiotherapy and PF 0.2g/ time for TID were started one week later until progression.

coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 single-arm study (translational subset). Only 'TMZ' is a registered intervention, but its description says every patient receives continuous TMZ 50 mg/m2, re-irradiation, 'PF' 0.2 g TID and pembrolizumab (TRPP = TMZ + radiotherapy + PD-1 + PF, presumably). Pembrolizumab and PF coded experimental_combination with regimen_id TRPP. PF identity unknown (other names list 'PD-1, RF'); moiety left as 'pf'. TMZ in a new continuous low-dose schedule at recurrence coded established_therapy_experiment. 11C-MET PET is used for routine response assessment and not listed.
